About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, execution-focused, and intellectually curious operator to join the Rider team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will own two of the most exciting growth vectors in KSA: airports, one of Uber's highest-intent, highest-value use cases and strategic portfolio bets, where you'll help identify, launch, and scale new opportunities and premium mobility products.

This is a highly cross-functional and analytical role. You will work closely with local teams across Operations, Business Development, Marketing, Policy and other functions, as well as regional and global Operations teams. You will be expected to combine strong analytical thinking with hands-on execution, moving comfortably between identifying an opportunity in the data and working with teams on the ground to bring a solution to life. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, is comfortable working with data, and takes ownership of moving projects from idea to execution.

What You'll Do

  • Own Airport Rider Growth and Performance: Own the Rider performance of Uber's airport portfolio in Saudi Arabia. Monitor airport demand, conversion, reliability, ETA, product mix and other key rider metrics to identify opportunities and drive improvements.
  • Improve the Airport Rider Experience: Identify and solve friction points across the airport rider journey, including pickup experience, pickup locations, wayfinding, product availability and the overall experience of requesting and taking an Uber from an airport.
  • Use Data to Identify Opportunities: Build a deep understanding of airport rider behavior through SQL, dashboards and other analytical tools. Diagnose performance gaps, size opportunities, develop hypotheses and translate insights into clear actions.
  • Execute Airport Growth Initiatives: Take ownership of the operational execution of airport initiatives and partnerships within the Rider scope. Work closely with Business Development and Operations teams, while supporting the execution of new commercial opportunities where relevant to the Rider experience.
  • Bring Best Practices to Saudi Arabia: Partner with EMEA and global teams to understand what is working across other Uber markets, including new airport products, features, experiments and operational best practices. Identify opportunities to test or adapt relevant solutions for Saudi Arabia.
  • Own Strategic Growth Initiatives: Lead a portfolio of strategic Rider growth initiatives outside the core Rider funnel. Take opportunities from initial hypothesis and sizing through business case development, pilot design, launch, measurement and iteration.
  • Launch and Scale New Use Cases: Support the launch and growth of new rider use cases and products in Saudi Arabia, by developing the local operating plan, coordinating launch requirements and monitoring performance after launch.
  • Grow Premium Products: Identify and execute opportunities to grow products such as Black and Comfort, with a focus on improving the rider experience, increasing product consideration and driving relevant riders toward the right product for their use case.
  • Deliver Rider Strategies for Major Events: Develop and execute Rider plans for major events, working cross-functionally to understand expected demand, identify rider experience requirements and ensure Uber is well positioned to serve riders during high-demand moments.
  • Engage External Partners: Participate in discussions with external partners and stakeholders where relevant to your portfolio, you will represent the Rider perspective and independently manage execution discussions when appropriate.
  • Be an Owner: Many of the opportunities within this portfolio will not have an existing playbook. Bring structure to ambiguous problems, identify what needs to happen next, and proactively drive projects forward while keeping relevant stakeholders closely aligned.

What You'll Need

  • 3-4 years of experience in Operations, Strategy, Growth, Management Consulting, Technology, Marketplace businesses, or a related field.
  • Strong business and operational acumen, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems and translate them into clear, actionable plans.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to use data to identify opportunities, diagnose problems and make decisions.
  • Proficiency in SQL and comfort independently working with large datasets, dashboards and performance metrics.
  • Proven project and program management skills, with experience taking initiatives from problem definition through execution and measurement.
  • Strong executional excellence and a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently with both internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to balance rider experience, growth, operational feasibility and commercial considerations.
  • A proactive and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to operate effectively when the path forward is not immediately clear.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Fluency in English.

Great to Have

  • Arabic language proficiency.
  • Experience in mobility, marketplaces, travel, airports, transportation, consumer technology or another high-growth industry.

As a member of Uber’s Offensive Security team, you will build the security tools, platforms, and AI-powered automation that enable security testing and risk reduction at Uber scale. You will develop software that automates and enhances security processes including security design reviews, threat modeling, penetration testing, vulnerability discovery and validation, and AI agent security testing. This role combines strong software engineering with an automation-first mindset, applying AI and frontier models to transform traditionally manual security processes into continuous, scalable capabilities integrated across Uber’s technology ecosystem.

The problems here are messy and the systems are global. You’ll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end-to-end, and stay calm when high-load systems are on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring, and believe that the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross-functional collaboration. If you’re energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world - this is where you’ll grow.

  • Develop AI-powered agents and workflows that analyze source code and technical designs, orchestrate security assessments, generate test cases, and validate findings.
  • Partner with security engineers to translate their expertise into repeatable, scalable capabilities.

  • Experience with security designs related to cloud-native services, microservices, or distributed systems.

  • Experience disassembling and reassembling vehicles, mechanical systems, or complex electromechanical equipment.

You will serve as the operational owner for key funnel processes and technologies, primarily LeanData, that leads are accurately routed, sellers receive the right opportunities quickly, and funnel processes are measurable, scalable, and increasingly automated.

About the Role

The Strategy & Planning Lead will serve as a strategic advisor and thought partner to Global Marketing leadership, driving high-impact initiatives that accelerate growth, improve operational effectiveness, and maximize the return on marketing investments. This role sits at the intersection of corporate strategy, marketing, operations, analytics, and executive communications.

As a trusted partner to senior leaders, you will oversee strategic planning, investment prioritization, organizational effectiveness, and executive engagement across the marketing organization. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities to drive greater impact with existing resources, solving complex business challenges, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that influence company and marketing strategy.

The ideal candidate is highly self-directed, thrives in ambiguity, and brings deep experience in strategy, marketing, business operations, and executive stakeholder management. They are equally comfortable conducting rigorous analysis, developing executive-level narratives, leading cross-functional initiatives, and influencing senior leaders.

What You'll Do

Strategic Planning & Investment Management

  • Drive annual and quarterly strategic planning processes across Global Marketing, partnering with leadership to define priorities, roadmap, investment allocations, and success metrics.
  • Develop business cases and investment scenarios to optimize marketing resource allocation and maximize growth impact.
  • Evaluate portfolio and market opportunities, recommending strategic shifts based on business performance, market dynamics, and organizational priorities.
  • Partner with Finance and Marketing leadership to establish planning frameworks that balance growth ambitions with operational discipline.

Growth Strategy & Business Performance

  • Analyze marketing performance, business trends, customer insights, and market opportunities to identify growth levers and strategic recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready analyses and recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness, ROI, and organizational efficiency.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive developments, and emerging opportunities to proactively identify risks and areas for investment.
  • Build frameworks that enable the organization to do more with less through prioritization, resource optimization, and scalable operating models.

Executive Communications & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Own executive engagement strategies and partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop clear, compelling narratives around marketing strategy and business priorities.
  • Lead development of executive presentations, leadership reviews, board-level materials, strategic memos, and organizational communications.
  • Translate complex analyses into concise recommendations that influence decision-making at the highest levels of the organization.
  • Serve as a key liaison between Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners across the business.

Strategic Initiatives 

  • Lead complex cross-functional projects that advance marketing and business priorities, from problem definition through implementation and impact measurement.
  • Partner closely with Operations, Data Science, Finance, Product, Regional teams, and other stakeholders to solve critical business challenges.
  • Establish operating mechanisms, governance processes, and performance management frameworks that improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Drive initiatives that increase operational rigor, simplify decision-making, and improve execution across the marketing organization.

Leadership Partnership

  • Act as a strategic thought partner and advisor to Marketing leadership on key business decisions, organizational priorities, and emerging opportunities.
  • Identify and advocate for high-priority initiatives that support both marketing objectives and broader company growth goals.
  • Support leadership in navigating ambiguity, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution against strategic objectives.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Strategy, Marketing Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting, Corporate Strategy, or related functions.
  • Experience supporting senior executives or marketing organizations in a Strategy & Operations, Chief of Staff, or equivalent strategic leadership capacity.
  • Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills with experience synthesizing large, complex datasets into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including extensive experience developing executive-level communications and presentations.
  • Demonstrated track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced and highly ambiguous environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across multiple organizational levels.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within high-growth technology, marketplace, consumer, or digital marketing organizations.
  • Deep understanding of marketing strategy, growth levers, customer acquisition, brand investment, and performance measurement.
  • Experience leading annual planning, investment allocation, and organizational transformation efforts.
  • Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience partnering with Finance, Data Science, Operations, and Product teams to solve strategic business challenges.

About team:

At Uber, we're not just moving people and things; we're building a global business grounded in integrity. Our Financial Risk Management (FRM) Advisory team is the backbone of that integrity, ensuring our financial reporting is accurate, trustworthy, and compliant with the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX).

As a Senior on this team, you'll be on the front lines, safeguarding our financial data and helping us navigate the complexities of a dynamic, global company. This isn't just about checking boxes—it's about asking the right questions, acting with conviction, and boldly improving our processes to drive meaningful outcomes and maintain the trust of our stakeholders.

What you will do:

Uber's technology platform reimagines the way people and things move in cities around the world by connecting drivers, riders, and eaters. We offer a variety of services including:

  • Ridesharing: Connecting riders with drivers for convenient transportation.
  • Delivery: Connecting consumers with restaurants and stores for food, groceries, and other deliveries.
  • Freight: Connecting shippers and carriers in the logistics space.  

Job Responsibilities - FRM Advisory Senior - Business Process

  • Strategic Risk Advisory & Governance: Serve as the lead advisor to business process owners in the orchestration and maintenance of a robust internal control environment. This includes championing the integration of risk management principles—including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance—throughout the end-to-end project lifecycle to ensure risk mitigation is embedded into business operations by design.
  • Control Evaluation and Monitoring: Conduct end-to-end evaluations of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR) to ensure the integrity and accuracy of financial disclosures. This responsibility entails executing risk diagnostics, assessing the design and operational effectiveness of controls, mapping key financial statement assertions to control activities, and monitoring the effectiveness of controls.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a primary liaison to key stakeholders, including business process owners, as well as internal and external audit teams. Cultivate and maintain professional relationships to facilitate effective communication and alignment on program objectives. 
  • Learning and Development: Serve as a subject matter expert in promoting risk awareness across designated business areas. This can be done by facilitating high-level training sessions that translate complex FRM concepts into actionable knowledge, ensuring process owners understand the strategic importance of risk identification and the value of a robust control environment.
  • Deficiency Management and Remediation: Assist in the process for identifying and evaluating control deficiencies. Investigate root causes, partner with business units to ensure corrective action plans are appropriate, and monitor remediation efforts through to successful completion.
  • Process Enhancements and Optimization: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the organization. Identify and recommend opportunities to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of compliance activities through control optimization, process automation, and the application of data analytics or AI.
  • Team Mentorship and Development: Provide mentorship and professional guidance to new or junior analysts. This includes reviewing work products, delivering constructive feedback, and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Assist in the preparation of clear and concise reports for Financial Risk Management (FRM) leadership and key stakeholders. These communications will articulate the purpose and status of risks related to key initiatives, such as, but not limited to, SOX compliance. This reporting will provide actionable insights that strengthen the organization's risk posture and operational resilience. 
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay abreast of changes in SOX and other related regulations and best practices, and ensure the company's compliance program is updated accordingly. This includes monitoring changes to PCAOB auditing standards and SEC guidance.  

Additional Skills

To be successful in this role, the ideal candidate should possess the following additional skills:

  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to distill complex financial concepts for any audience, from engineers to executives. You can articulate risk in a way that is clear, concise, and compelling.
  • A Sharp, Analytical Mind: Drive and curiosity to dig into details, connecting the dots between processes, and solving complex puzzles. Solving problems with critical thinking and a meticulous eye for detail.
  • Adaptability and Resilience: A flexible mindset that is comfortable navigating ambiguity and thriving in Uber's fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.
  • Automation & AI Aptitude: A digital-first mindset dedicated to identifying automation opportunities and leveraging emerging AI technologies to scale organizational impact.
  • Digital Transformation Aptitude: Proven ability to identify automation opportunities and leverage emerging AI technologies to enhance risk oversight. The ability to thrive at the nexus of technology and financial risk by championing automated workflows and the deployment of real-time, AI-powered control environments.
  • Strong Business Acumen: A genuine curiosity about how Uber's business operates and the ability to connect the dots between internal controls and our broader strategic goals.
  • Unwavering Integrity: A deep commitment to doing the right thing, with the courage to uphold the highest standards of professional conduct and ethical judgment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in SOX, internal audit, or public accounting (Big 4 experience is a plus).
  • CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, or other relevant professional certification is highly preferred.

Uber Advertising division spearheads the growth of our advertising business by building a suite of products that enable brands to reach highly engaged users across our Mobility and Delivery platforms. As a Client Partner, you will be responsible for building new partnerships with our largest brands, acting as a strategic advisor in a fast-changing environment where the answers aren’t always predefined.

This role is for those who are resilient and energized by the messy reality of doing big things at scale.
